description: This file contains implementation of object mapper operations for managing object descriptors, including registration, creation, serialization, and interpretation of object streams within a component-based system.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOmoRegisterObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * name,ULONG oid,char * baseName,ULONG baseOid,char * type,ULONG brokerOid,PFN_ANSC_OBJECT_CREATE pfnCreate,PFN_ANSC_OBJECT_REMOVE pfnRemove)
methods.description: Registers a new object descriptor in the object mapper with specified parameters, creating and adding the descriptor if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOmoCreateObjectByName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,char * name)
methods.description: Creates an object instance based on its registered name by retrieving the descriptor and invoking its creation method.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOmoCreateObjectByOid(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ULONG oid)
methods.description: Creates an object instance based on its object id by retrieving the descriptor and invoking its creation method.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOmoCreateObjectByType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,char * baseName,char * type)
methods.description: Creates an object instance based on base name and type by retrieving the descriptor and invoking its creation method.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscOmoGetObjectByRid(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG rid)
methods.description: Maps a runtime object id to its handle, here simply returning the id cast as a handle.

methods.name: ULONG AnscOmoGetObjectsCount(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Counts the total number of object descriptors registered within the object mapper.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOmoSerialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSerialized)
methods.description: Serializes the object descriptor table into a stream, copying relevant descriptor fields into a tag array.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscOmoInterpret(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSerialized,ULONG ulCount)
methods.description: Interprets a serialized stream to reconstruct object descriptors by creating new descriptors and setting their properties accordingly.

ctags.name: AnscOmoRegisterObject
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * name,ULONG oid,char * baseName,ULONG baseOid,char * type,ULONG brokerOid,PFN_ANSC_OBJECT_CREATE pfnCreate,PFN_ANSC_OBJECT_REMOVE pfnRemove)
